verdict: No correctness defect found in independently inspected single-pass source refinement. Source preserves previous PR110 victim ordering; no adoption or target deadline qualification asserted.
scope: Read-only comparison of source, newactualIRQ fixture and victim parity harness; no builds/tests/edits by reviewer.
proof: Released-voice pass still selects minimum envelope and returns immediately, preserving higher priority.

Second pass still selects the oldest extra held voice by global age. Its else-if caches only live, held, non-stage-4 voices that failed extra eligibility. It does not misclassify extras whose age failed the best comparison: the outer if still takes its branch.

When an extra exists, the protected cache is ignored. When none exists and sustained overload is set, the cache contains exactly the former voice_victim category-4 candidates: lowest held POLY or index-zero non-POLY. Strict less-than and identical track/slot traversal retain the first candidate on age ties.
allow_protected snapshots audio-owned shed_over. Nested TIMER5 does not write it; the main loop cannot interleave ALNK0. No ordering difference identified.
Four-track preprocessing excludes new declarations, cache branch and fallback. Native voice_kill remains immediate and only retires one voice. No extra DSP voice starts.
Empty candidate cache stays NULL; final check prevents a kill. Continued overload below eight remains eligible, allowing repeated reductions until no eligible voice remains.

New actual-IRQ fixture covers protected UNISON, lowest POLY at a nonzero index, PHYS body liveness after shedding/retrigger/note-off, and previous sustained/transient/recovery/auxiliary/priority cases.

Parity harness invokes actual old/new shed_voice functions in separately compiled identical fixtures across 65536 deterministic states seeded DABB1801. It uses at most eight active descriptors, varied modes/engines, arbitrary ages, gate/release/stage-4 state and overload history, and hashes output state. This is a differential oracle against PR110 rather than independent numerical policy expectations; source proof complements it.
limitations: Parent target measurements reported but not independently reanalysed by this reviewer; compiled static IRQ model is not physical cycles.
Parity hash collision risk is nonzero; this is not exhaustive coverage of every engine/lifetime/state.
Actual IRQ fixture uses a simulated clock. Full IRQ nested stack/deadlines and click quality remain open.
Reverse SLICE-specific shed/reuse is not newly tested, although PHYS now covers a heavy-body lifecycle.
An explicit equal-age tie fixture would strengthen deterministic ordering coverage; strict less-than and identical traversal already support expected tie behaviour.
